en.title: On the Nameless Loss Sleeping in a Crystal Coffin
en.premise: I am the librarian of an underground library where the memories discarded by people are preserved as crystals. One day, guided by a nameless cat, a nameless girl arrives seeking a fragment of her past. To grant a wish so fragile it might shatter at a single touch, I venture into the forbidden archives. This is a cruel yet gentle tale of two souls who loved a beautiful despair, seeking to fill the voids within one another.

zh.title: 关于沉睡在水晶棺中的，无名的丧失
zh.premise: 我是地下图书馆的司书，负责将人们舍弃的记忆以结晶的形式保存。某日，一名寻找记忆碎片的无名少女，在一只无名之猫的引导下拜访了我。为了实现她那触之即碎般脆弱的愿望，我踏入了禁忌的书库。这是一个热爱着绝美绝望的我们，为了填补彼此缺失而展开的，残酷而温柔的故事。
